script.title: Japanese Buddhist Temple Precinct
script.description: A sacred Japanese Buddhist temple precinct featuring a monumental Kondo (Main Hall) on a raised stone terrace with an open engawa veranda, authentic dougong bracket complexes, a gilded Buddha sanctum, a freestanding Shoro (Bell Tower) with bronze bonsho bell, a Sanmon mountain gate with tile roof, a Chozuya water purification pavilion, stone lanterns, a Zen rock garden, and sculpted Japanese pine and cherry blossom trees.
